# Glossary {#sec-apph}

Every acronym, YAML key and symbol the chapters use, with the meaning its first-use note gives and the section that
defines it, and the named methods the prose refers to (such as the Riemann solver). The list is generated from
`tools/reader-glossary.json`, the book's one concept registry; a symbol is defined by its group of the notation index
(@sec-appa-index), an acronym by the section that writes out its expansion, a key by the table row or the sentence
that says what it is. Where no section defines a concept, the entry says "not defined here" and links the first
section that uses it.
